data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 43.15m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a net favourable movement on prior years of approximately GBP 3.50m (a release), driven by run-off on the older 2018 underwriting year. The syndicate nevertheless experienced significant 2020 loss activity (notably Hurricane Sally) and recognised additional COVID-19 related reserves, while prior-year run-off and reinsurance recoveries produced the reported prior-year release.
raw_causal_phrases: higher than expected claims activity in the year.
Loss activity during 2020 means that the 2019 and 2020 years of account are forecast to make modest losses also.
The net loss ratio of 96% (2019: 78%) reflects the impact of major losses, notably Hurricane Sally on the Property lines.
Additional reserves have also been recognised in relation to potential COVID-19 losses, adding 3.7 percentage points to the net claims ratio.
Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m (2019: GBP 1.8m).
On an ultimate basis, the 2018 year of account has closed at a loss of GBP 6.1m.
The 2019 result included the Syndicate's exposure to two loss events, Typhoon Faxai and Hagibis.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: narrative and a line-by-line 'favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m' is stated net of reinsurance. A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims movements for UW years <=2018) resulting in a ~GBP 3.502m release. The per-line PYD table in the notes appears to be net-of-reinsurance by line/class (and was used for lob_movements), so those line amounts may be net not gross. Use caution: gross vs net is ambiguous in some note tables; the prior_year_development_gbp_m value above uses the gross claims development triangle (preferred for gross movement).
